title: Legal Research Methodology And Project Writing Ii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used when a legal researcher intends to anticipate and highlight possible misuse of the proposed law or legal measure."
Predictive legal studies are used when a legal researcher intends to anticipate and highlight possible misuse of the proposed law or legal measure.

A comma is used to separate two independent clauses joined by ―and‖, ―but,‖ ―or,‖ ―for,‖ ―nor,‖ or ―yet‖.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most commonly used method of data collection in the study of human behaviour."
Interview is the most commonly used method of data collection in the study of human behaviour.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that may be joined by ―and‖: erratic, vague testimony (―erratic‖ and ―vague‖ both modify ―testimony‖)."
Coordinate adjectives are those that may be joined by ―and‖: erratic, vague testimony (―erratic‖ and ―vague‖ both modify ―testimony‖).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with analysis and interpretation of data."
The completion stage is concerned with analysis and interpretation of data.

Inter-disciplinary legal research is a research endeavour undertaken jointly by scholars belonging to different disciplines.

Quasi-disciplinary legal research is a research undertaken by the same scholar of law in different perspectives that transgress the discipline of law.
